summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline using LightGBM and Stratified K-Fold CV, but critically fails by applying TF-IDF, TruncatedSVD, and frequency encoding on the combined train and test datasets. This leads to severe data leakage from the test set. Additionally, there are minor bugs in string missing-value imputation and a risk of execution errors with TruncatedSVD if a text column yields exactly two features.
